name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-europa

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the EU open-data portal (data.europa.eu) for datasets by free-text query; supports Solr filter expressions (e.g. country.iso:DE), pagination via rows/start, and sorting. Returns dataset titles, descriptions, and publisher info.

tools.name: package
tools.description: Fetch a single EU open-data dataset record by its portal ID, returning full metadata including title, description, publisher, license, distributions, and tags.

tools.name: organizations
tools.description: List EU open-data portal publishing organizations (EU institutions, member-state agencies, etc.) with their names and dataset counts; limit controls page size (default 100, max 1000).

tools.name: groups
tools.description: List thematic dataset categories (groups) on the EU open-data portal (e.g. environment, transport, economy); returns category names and IDs for use as filters in search.

tools.name: tags
tools.description: List or search keyword tags used to annotate datasets on the EU open-data portal; pass query to filter by prefix, limit controls page size (default 100).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-europa forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-europa pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
